name: arcade
description: Tic-tac-toe, sudoku, tetris, video poker, blackjack and UNO in a side pane, playable by keyboard, mouse or an Xbox controller

tttLevel.title: Tic-tac-toe level
tttLevel.description: easy: the computer plays random legal moves. hard: it never loses.

sudokuDifficulty.title: Sudoku difficulty
sudokuDifficulty.description: How many clues a new puzzle keeps: easy 40, medium 32, hard about 26.

tetrisSpeed.title: Tetris speed
tetrisSpeed.description: normal: gravity speeds up with the level. zen: it stays at one row a second.

unoOpponents.title: UNO opponents
unoOpponents.description: How many computer players sit at the UNO table.

pauseOnTurnEnd.title: Pause when Claude finishes
pauseOnTurnEnd.description: Pause a running game when Claude's turn ends, so a finished answer does not go unseen.

controller.title: Use an Xbox controller
controller.description: Start the Windows XInput helper (bin/pad.exe) when the pane opens, if it is built.
